name: @sint-willibrordkerk/liturgical-calendar
author: Sint Willibrordus Stichting
description: Generate a (local) Catholic liturgical calendar in accordance with the 1960 rubrics. Each language of the propers is published separately.

scripts.start: pnpm build && pnpm build:languages && node scripts/main.js
scripts.build:languages: node scripts/build-language.mjs languages/la && node scripts/build-language.mjs languages/nl
